description: This file defines an abstract class 'Finder' in the 'org.apache.ofbiz.entity.finder' package. It provides a template for entity finders with methods to handle entity name and cache settings, and requires subclasses to implement the 'runFind' method for executing the find logic.

classes.name: Finder
classes.description: An abstract class representing a generic entity finder with configurable entity name and cache options, meant to be extended by specific finder implementations.

methods.name: getEntityNameExdr
methods.description: Returns the FlexibleStringExpander used for the entity name.

methods.name: getUseCacheStrExdr
methods.description: Returns the FlexibleStringExpander used for cache setting.

methods.name: getEntityName
methods.description: Retrieves the entity name if it doesn't contain expansion syntax; otherwise, returns null.

methods.name: setEntityName
methods.description: Sets the entity name using a string value, creating a new FlexibleStringExpander.

methods.name: runFind
methods.description: Abstract method to execute the find operation, to be implemented by subclasses.
